title: Tracks per album
statementMd:
For each album with tracks show title and track count; list the five largest albums, ties by title.

Expected columns: `title`, `tracks`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT al.title, COUNT(*) AS tracks FROM tracks t JOIN albums al ON al.id = t.album_id GROUP BY al.id, al.title ORDER BY tracks DESC, al.title LIMIT 5;
```
